facts.statement: Atrium is the game discovery, marketplace presentation and multiplayer coordination project; it is not the TaviX package installer.
TheBigTreeInc/atrium is a reachable GitHub source repository with default branch main.
GitHub main package.json and the extracted 0.5.82 ZipRunner source ZIP both declare 0.5.82. The 0.5.83 registry update is a candidate only.
Canonical project UUID is not present in inspected project.zr, package.json or current shared catalog; GitHub numeric repository ID is not a project UUID.
Atrium display-only TaviX marketplace uses an independently approved and hash-pinned repository index; installation and trust stay with Tavi/TaviX.
Social contact/challenge adapter and Life lobby tests exist, but trusted runtime and real two-client Life admission remain unmounted/unaccepted.
Atrium 0.5.82 includes optional Tavi Assets 0.1.11 SDK bridge; host grant and entitlement approval are separate.
Source QA is not Windows ZipRunner acceptance, GitHub publication, TaviX approval or release.
Delivered 0.5.82 ZIP omitted root AGENTS.md and engineering instructions known to exist on GitHub main; full source checkout equivalence is not verified.

facts.statement: Thirteen old Atrium Library files are retained in place because their original bytes are not currently materializable for safe move verification.

Atrium source 0.5.84 extends its existing independently scoped Market Grove LoopRD child with one global simulated order book, 44 fictional instruments, 20 bot strategies/200 accounts, reference ingestion, and practice-only balances. Real spendable Gold settlement is not implemented and requires a separately authorized Tavi Wallet contract.
